translated_title: Meeting With Felipe VI Was Achieved Thanks to Spain's Recognition of the Abuses of the Conquest: Sheinbaum
original_title: Reunión con Felipe VI se logró gracias a reconocimiento de España de los abusos de la Conquista: Sheinbaum

meta_description: Sheinbaum made Indigenous rights her first topic with the king, who pledged a session on original peoples at November's Ibero-American Summit in Madrid.
